Class ResearchPaper

java.lang.Object
project.models.others.ResearchPaper
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ResearchPaper>
public class ResearchPaper extends Object implements Comparable<ResearchPaper>, Serializable
An academic research paper with metadata and citation tracking. Natural ordering is by citation count descending — most-cited papers sort first.
